title: Sync skill/agent surfaces and docs with the mode-aware documenter
description: Update agents/bober-documenter.md, skills/bober.sprint/SKILL.md, and skills/bober.run/SKILL.md so the skill-engine flow mirrors the TS pipeline: read documenter.docsMode/docsDir from bober.config.json, resolve the sprint record path, and only instruct committing in 'committed' mode. Regenerate .claude copies (update-all), document the new keys in the config reference with solo-vs-team recipes, and record the change in CHANGELOG.md.

successCriteria.description: skills/bober.sprint/SKILL.md and skills/bober.run/SKILL.md documenter steps instruct the orchestrator to read documenter.docsMode and documenter.docsDir from bober.config.json, describe the three modes' behavior (committed/local/external), and pass the resolved record path + commit policy into the documenter prompt instead of the hardcoded 'docs/sprints/<contractId>.md ... commit ONLY the doc files' text.

agents/bober-documenter.md gates all commit instructions and the docs/sprints default on the mode passed in by the orchestrator; in non-committed modes it forbids editing any repo file except the sprint record and routes stale-doc findings into 'concerns'.

The repo's copy-sync check reports zero NEW drift for the files owned by this sprint: run `node scripts/update-all.mjs --check .` and confirm the three owned copies (.claude/agents/bober-documenter.md, .claude/commands/bober-sprint.md, .claude/commands/bober-run.md) are in-sync/byte-identical with their canonical sources. Pre-existing drift in files outside this sprint's scope (e.g. bober-plan.md, bober-seo*) is NOT a failure and must NOT be 'fixed' by this sprint.

The configuration reference (VISION.md and/or README.md, wherever the documenter section is documented) lists docsMode and docsDir with defaults and a short solo-vs-team recipe; CHANGELOG.md gains an entry for the feature.
npm run typecheck, lint, build and the full test suite still pass (docs-only sprint must not regress anything).

generatorNotes: Hardcoded strings to replace: skills/bober.sprint/SKILL.md:380-409 (documenter spawn step; :402 hardcodes docs/sprints and unconditional commit), skills/bober.run/SKILL.md:562-568 (same pattern), agents/bober-documenter.md:64 (record path), :92-94 (related docs), :121 (result JSON sprintDocPath example). Keep the advisory-failure semantics text intact (documenter crash never fails the sprint). Check scripts/ + package.json for the exact update-all invocation and .claude copy layout before editing — copies must be regenerated, not hand-edited. Config reference: grep VISION.md and README.md for the documenter section added in PR #42 (branch bober/docs-documenter-simplicity); follow its table/format. CHANGELOG.md: follow the existing entry format (see 0.19.0 entry). Voice discipline per AGENTS.md: do not soften Iron-Law/EXTREMELY-IMPORTANT phrasing anywhere. NEGOTIATED: the canonical drift check is `npm run update-all:check` (scripts/update-all.mjs --check). CARRY-FORWARD CONCERNS from sprint 1's documenter (address in prose where the md surfaces describe modes; do NOT change TS code): (a) docsMode 'local' with a docsDir outside the repo cannot be gitignored — md surfaces should say out-of-repo output belongs to 'external'; (b) setting docsDir explicitly yields absolute paths in tracked history.jsonl — an explicit opt-in, worth one sentence in the config reference.
evaluatorNotes: sc-2-1/sc-2-2: read the three md files; confirm (a) explicit instruction to read documenter.docsMode/docsDir from bober.config.json, (b) all three modes described with correct semantics matching sprint 1's TS implementation (compare against src/orchestrator/documenter-agent.ts prompt builder), (c) no remaining unconditional 'commit the doc files' instruction. sc-2-3: run the copy-sync check command and paste its output. sc-2-4: confirm docsMode/docsDir documented with defaults ('committed', docs/sprints) and team recipe present; CHANGELOG entry exists. sc-2-5: full suite + typecheck + lint + build. Also grep the whole repo for remaining hardcoded 'docs/sprints' occurrences and confirm each survivor is intentional (e.g. describing the default).
nonGoals: Do not change TS runtime behavior in this sprint — src/ is frozen except where a doc-comment correction is unavoidable.
Do not hand-edit generated .claude copies — regenerate them with the repo's update-all script.
Do not soften Iron-Law/EXTREMELY-IMPORTANT voice in behavior-shaping content (AGENTS.md prohibition).
Do not rewrite the documenter's record content guidance — only where the record goes and whether it is committed.
stopConditions: All three md surfaces (agents/bober-documenter.md, skills/bober.sprint/SKILL.md, skills/bober.run/SKILL.md) describe the three docsMode behaviors and read the mode from bober.config.json.
The copy-sync drift check reports zero drift.
Config reference + CHANGELOG updated; full suite still green.
definitionOfDone: The skill-engine documenter flow mirrors the TS pipeline: orchestrator instructions read documenter.docsMode/docsDir from bober.config.json and gate commit instructions on 'committed' mode; agents/bober-documenter.md gates its commit steps on the mode passed in; .claude copies are regenerated with zero drift; docsMode/docsDir are documented with solo-vs-team recipes and a CHANGELOG entry exists; typecheck/lint/build/tests stay green.
assumptions: The config reference for the documenter section lives in VISION.md and/or README.md (added by PR #42); the generator locates it by grepping for 'documenter'.
npm run update-all (see package.json/scripts) is the canonical copy-sync mechanism and supports a --check drift mode.
